subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: When requester wake succeeds but required visible message-tool delivery fails, should the run become terminal with visible delivery failed, or should visible delivery remain bounded and retryable?
rationale: Both models can be implemented safely, but they produce different user-visible recovery behavior after parent orchestration resumes, so repository intent is required.

options.title: Terminal split outcome
options.body: Preserve requester wake, record visible delivery as failed, clear pending state, and stop retrying visible output.

options.title: Bounded visible retry
options.body: Preserve requester wake while retaining a retryable visible-delivery state until success or a defined retry limit.

recommendation.title: Terminal split outcome
recommendation.body: Preserve requester wake, record visible delivery as failed, clear pending state, and stop retrying visible output.
